caveats: Goods only; no services. Chapters aggregate all available HS6 product records, not a top-product sample.
BACI reconciles exporter and importer reports and converts import CIF to FOB; these are source estimates, not two independent country reports.
Values converted from thousand current USD to nearest current USD after aggregation. No inflation adjustment.
Null indicates no observed positive source flow in that direction; it is not an observed zero.
Year 2015–2024 only; no earlier product composition or 2025 values inferred.
Country identifiers follow BACI; modern country views are not backcast onto historical empires.
The same flow appears as an export in one country view and an import in its partner view; do not sum both to get a world total.
Route lines connect country reference points; these are not physical shipping routes.
aggregation: Sum all available source HS6 v by year, exporter, importer, first two HS digits. Store country-relative exports and imports; preserve absent directions as null.
